podcast.body: The Bangles' 1984 debut album is noted as a "great sounding record." Before their mainstream success as a Top 40 band, they were part of the alternative scene known as The Paisley Underground. "Their debut album from 1984 is still a great sounding record."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Driven By Her: History of Female Drummers
